brief.ask: Create the brand family for Lumenfold, the office suite in this monorepo: the Lumenfold master brand and product icons for Lumenfold Docs, Sheets and Sign.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: privacy-first and European, calm and precise. The three product icons must clearly belong to one family and still be told apart at small sizes. Web apps only.

claim.notes: All three directions (Crease, Lightfall, Folded L) got a critic 'none' in both sketch rounds because the product icons blurred together at 16 px and read as stock shapes (page dog-ear, door, tray), so none reached the quality gate and nothing was finalized, exported or installed.

concepts.title: Crease
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a page with a dog-eared corner (brief explicitly avoids it; Docs and Sign members are the plain folded-corner page); s2 a letter L split by a 45-degree cut, the initial-with-a-cut device, and nearly identical to folded-l s1; s3 a speaker/volume icon (rectangle + trapezoid), Sign member a square plus sliver. Family: members differ only by proportion and blur together at 16 px. Different move: stop drawing the sheet or the L; find a fold whose result is a new silhouette (e.g. a folded strip that encloses a light counter) and give each product a distinct fold count or direction, not a stretched copy.

concepts.title: Folded L
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a letter L cut by a diagonal (initial with a cut), same drawing as crease s2; members at 16 px differ only by foot length; s2 a stepped L holding a cup, reads as a sink/tray or toaster, the inset is a nested copy and goes muddy at 16 px; s3 a square nested in an L frame, a crop/picture-frame icon, near-primitive (0.905 square). Different move: if the L stays, it must come from the fold itself, not from an L silhouette with a slit; e.g. a single band whose turn-over creates the L counter in negative space, with the light underside as the only colour accent, and product members distinguished by a clear glyph-level cue.

concepts.title: Lightfall
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: n1 an open door or two standing panels/book spread; Docs and Sign are near identical at 16 px; n2 tilted stacked bars, speed lines or stairs; Sheets member is literally a hamburger menu, Sign a lone slash, Docs two rectangles, so the members do not belong together; n3 two pennants / fast-forward arrows, Sheets member is a sailboat, Sign reads as play arrows. No fold reads in any of them. Different move: one constant light device (e.g. a single lit fold edge between two planes at a fixed angle) repeated in every member, with products told apart by one clear secondary cue, not by recomposition.
